CENTRE FOR NUCLEAR MEDICINE

22.08.2026
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY (01)
Applications are invited for appointment of Guest Faculty (01) in the Centre for Nuclear
Medicine to teach following subjects for the odd semesters of the academic session 2026-27.
Days of Teaching Classes to be taught Subject to be taught
Monday to Friday M.Sc. Nuclear Medicine 1. Radiation Physics and
Applied Mathematics
2. Radiation Detection and
Measurements
Essential Qualifications:
(i) M.Sc. in Nuclear Medicine/ Physics from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree
from an accredited foreign University with good academic record as defined by the
concerned University with at least 55% of the marks (50% in case of SC/ST/OBC/Physically
& Visually handicapped) or an equivalent grade in a point wherever grading system is
followed at Master’s degree level.
(ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR. The candidates, who are, or have
been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission
(Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009, shall be
exempted from the requirement of the minimum eligibility condition of NET for recruitment
and appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in
Universities/Colleges/Institutions.
(iii) NET shall not be required for such disciplines for which NET is not conducted.
Honorarium:
The appointment of Guest Faculty is on lecture basis with token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidates shall have to give an
undertaking that he /she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from
any agency and will do the same till they are teaching in the Centre for Nuclear Medicine as
Guest Faculty. The candidates who are already availing JRF scholarships in the University
are not entitled for the honorarium but they will be issued experience certificate for the Guest
Faculty in case they selected.
Instructions for applicants:
 Interested candidates are required to submit the hard copy of the application along
with the self attested copies of relevant certificates and documents to the office of the
Chairperson, Centre for Nuclear Medicine, Panjab University, Chandigarh by
28.08.2026 (Friday) till 5.00 pm.
 The interview will be held on 02.09.2026 at 12:00 noon at the Centre for Nuclear
Medicine, Panjab University.
 The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at the website
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf).
 All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification at the time of interview.
 No TA/DA will be paid for interview.
Sd/-
(Dr. Vijayta D. Chadha)
Chairperson
